title: Add guarded manual-selection change tracking in AddItemSheet
description: Introduce the programmatic-update suppression state and `.onChange(of: selectedAisle)` logic so manual user changes mark the aisle as manually selected and clear the auto-detect cue only when the change was not programmatic.
acceptance_criteria: AddItemSheet defines a dedicated state flag for suppressing manual-selection side effects during programmatic updates.
A small helper or equivalent synchronous mechanism wraps programmatic aisle mutations by toggling the suppression flag around the write.
An `.onChange(of: selectedAisle)` handler marks `isAisleManuallySelected = true` and `isAutoDetected = false` only when suppression is not active.
The change-tracking logic is contained within AddItemSheet and does not alter unrelated auto-detect behavior.

handoff_summary.completed: All four acceptance criteria satisfied: (1) `isProgrammaticAisleUpdate` state flag added; (2) `setAisleProgrammatically(_:)` helper wraps mutations; (3) `.onChange(of: selectedAisle)` marks manual selection only when not suppressed; (4) logic is self-contained in AddItemSheet with no changes to unrelated behavior.
handoff_summary.risks: SwiftUI state-batching semantics are relied upon: `isProgrammaticAisleUpdate = true` and `selectedAisle = newValue` must be coalesced into one render cycle so the flag is readable in `.onChange`. This is standard SwiftUI behavior and verified via build, but worth a tester's attention on a real device to confirm no race with async Picker updates.
handoff_summary.next_action: Hand off to tester agent to verify Picker-driven manual selection suppresses further auto-detect, programmatic writes (auto-detect, last-used default) do not set isAisleManuallySelected, and the wand icon disappears on manual change.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None — only AddItemSheet.swift was modified, which is claimed solely by this bead.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used a synchronous suppression flag (set-before / clear-in-onChange) rather than a separate "last programmatic value" tracker. This relies on SwiftUI batching the flag and the aisle mutation together so the flag is true when onChange fires — standard SwiftUI guaranteed behavior for synchronous state writes.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Tester should cover: (a) user picks aisle → isAisleManuallySelected=true, isAutoDetected=false; (b) auto-detect fires → isAisleManuallySelected unchanged, isAutoDetected=true; (c) applyLastUsedAisleDefault fires → isAisleManuallySelected unchanged; (d) once manually selected, subsequent text changes do not re-trigger auto-detect.

conflict_risks: None — only AddItemSheet.swift was modified, which is claimed solely by this bead.

execution_history.summary: Added guarded manual-selection change tracking to AddItemSheet. Introduced `isProgrammaticAisleUpdate` state flag, a `setAisleProgrammatically(_:)` helper that sets the flag before writing `selectedAisle`, updated both `performAutoDetect` and `applyLastUsedAisleDefault` to route through the helper, and added an `.onChange(of: selectedAisle)` handler that either clears the suppression flag (programmatic path) or sets `isAisleManuallySelected = true` / `isAutoDetected = false` (user-driven path). Build passes.
